name: Otohara Rurino
source:
A rookie investigator at ADONIS Cybercrime Division 1.
She deeply respects his senior investigator Kuraugi, and constantly tries to get his attention.
In the case involving ‘Cheat Plant’, she partners with Kuraugi to conduct the investigation.
